module.name: Customs & Trade Compliance Module
module.description: Comprehensive customs, tariff, trade compliance, and regulatory requirements across 190+ countries. Includes HS code classification, duty calculation, FTA eligibility, restricted party screening, product-specific regulations (FDA, CE, RoHS, REACH), and Incoterms optimization.
module.expansion_logic: Base customs parameters are expanded across 195+ countries, 1000+ country-pair trade lanes, 10000+ HS codes, and 50+ product categories. Tariff rates updated quarterly, trade agreements monitored continuously, restricted party lists updated daily.
data_sources: WTO (World Trade Organization) Tariff Download Facility
BIS Entity List (US Bureau of Industry and Security)

update_frequencies.realtime: Restricted party lists (daily updates pushed within 24h)
update_frequencies.quarterly: Start of each quarter (Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1)
update_frequencies.ad_hoc: Upon trade agreement changes, tariff updates, new regulations

parameters.name: product_hs_code_6digit
parameters.purpose: 6-digit Harmonized System code for product (globally harmonized).

parameters.name: product_hs_code_8digit_country_specific
parameters.purpose: 8-digit HS code (country-specific subdivision).

parameters.name: product_hs_code_10digit_us_hts
parameters.purpose: 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule (US-specific).

parameters.name: product_hs_classification_confidence_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 confidence score of AI-generated HS code classification.

parameters.name: product_requires_import_license_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product requires import license in destination country.

parameters.name: product_import_license_type
parameters.purpose: Type of import license required (if any), e.g., 'automatic', 'non-automatic', 'phytosanitary'.
parameters.range: enum[none, automatic, non_automatic, phytosanitary, veterinary, other]

parameters.name: product_import_prohibited_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product import is prohibited in destination country.

parameters.name: product_import_quota_restricted_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is subject to import quotas.

parameters.name: product_quota_remaining_units
parameters.purpose: Remaining quota units available for current period (if quota applies).

parameters.name: tariff_rate_mfn_percent
parameters.purpose: Most Favored Nation (MFN) tariff rate as percentage.

parameters.name: tariff_rate_fta_percent
parameters.purpose: Free Trade Agreement (FTA) tariff rate if origin country has FTA with destination.

parameters.name: tariff_rate_gsp_percent
parameters.purpose: Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) tariff rate if origin country qualifies.

parameters.name: tariff_rate_applicable_percent
parameters.purpose: Actual applicable tariff rate (lowest of MFN, FTA, GSP).

parameters.name: tariff_specific_duty_per_unit
parameters.purpose: Specific duty (non-ad-valorem) per unit, e.g., $5 per kg.

parameters.name: tariff_compound_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether tariff is compound (both ad-valorem and specific).

parameters.name: vat_import_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Value-Added Tax (VAT) / Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate on imports.

parameters.name: excise_tax_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether excise tax applies (alcohol, tobacco, fuel, etc.).

parameters.name: excise_tax_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Excise tax rate as percentage (if applicable).

parameters.name: antidumping_duty_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether anti-dumping duty applies.

parameters.name: antidumping_duty_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Anti-dumping duty rate (if applicable).

parameters.name: countervailing_duty_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether countervailing duty (CVD) applies.

parameters.name: countervailing_duty_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Countervailing duty rate (if applicable).

parameters.name: retaliatory_tariff_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether retaliatory tariff (trade war) applies.

parameters.name: retaliatory_tariff_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Retaliatory tariff rate due to trade war (if applicable).

parameters.name: total_duty_and_tax_estimated_percent
parameters.purpose: Total estimated duty + VAT + excise as percentage of FOB value.

parameters.name: total_duty_and_tax_estimated_usd
parameters.purpose: Total estimated duty + VAT + excise in USD for this shipment.

parameters.name: fta_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether origin and destination countries have FTA.

parameters.name: fta_name
parameters.purpose: Name of applicable FTA, e.g., 'USMCA', 'CPTPP', 'EU-South Korea FTA'.

parameters.name: fta_product_eligible_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is eligible under FTA rules of origin.

parameters.name: fta_rules_of_origin_requirement
parameters.purpose: Description of rules of origin requirements (e.g., '50% local content').

parameters.name: fta_certificate_of_origin_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether Certificate of Origin required for FTA benefits.

parameters.name: fta_potential_savings_percent
parameters.purpose: Potential tariff savings percentage if FTA is used vs MFN.

parameters.name: fta_potential_savings_usd
parameters.purpose: Potential tariff savings in USD for this shipment using FTA.

parameters.name: gsp_applicable_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether origin country qualifies for GSP in destination.

parameters.name: gsp_product_eligible_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is eligible for GSP benefits.

parameters.name: duty_drawback_eligible_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is eligible for duty drawback (refund of duties on re-export).

parameters.name: duty_drawback_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of duties that can be reclaimed through drawback.

parameters.name: ftz_foreign_trade_zone_benefit_available_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) benefits available in destination.

parameters.name: ftz_duty_deferral_benefit_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether duties can be deferred using FTZ.

parameters.name: customs_valuation_method
parameters.purpose: Method used for customs valuation: 'transaction', 'deductive', 'computed', etc.
parameters.range: enum[transaction, identical_goods, similar_goods, deductive, computed, fallback]

parameters.name: customs_value_adjustment_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether customs value requires adjustment (royalties, assists, etc.).

parameters.name: customs_clearance_avg_time_hours
parameters.purpose: Average customs clearance time in hours for this product/country.

parameters.name: customs_clearance_time_stddev_hours
parameters.purpose: Standard deviation of customs clearance time (variability).

parameters.name: customs_inspection_probability_percent
parameters.purpose: Probability of physical inspection by customs (0-100%).

parameters.name: customs_broker_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether customs broker is required (mandatory in some countries).

parameters.name: customs_broker_fee_estimated_usd
parameters.purpose: Estimated customs broker fee in USD.

parameters.name: restricted_party_screening_supplier_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is on restricted party list (OFAC, BIS, EU, UN).

parameters.name: restricted_party_screening_buyer_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether buyer is on restricted party list.

parameters.name: restricted_party_screening_match_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 fuzzy match score if potential restricted party match found.

parameters.name: export_control_classification_eccn
parameters.purpose: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) for product (US).

parameters.name: export_license_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether export license required from origin country.

parameters.name: export_license_type
parameters.purpose: Type of export license required (if any).

parameters.name: dual_use_goods_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product classified as dual-use goods (civilian + military applications).

parameters.name: product_fda_regulated_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is regulated by US FDA.

parameters.name: product_fda_approval_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether FDA pre-market approval required.

parameters.name: product_fda_registration_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether facility registration with FDA required.

parameters.name: product_ce_marking_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether CE marking required for EU import.

parameters.name: product_rohs_compliant_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) compliant.

parameters.name: product_reach_compliant_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether product is REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization of Chemicals) compliant.

parameters.name: product_svhc_substances_count
parameters.purpose: Number of Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) in product.

parameters.name: product_weee_directive_applies_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether WEEE (Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment) Directive applies.

parameters.name: product_phytosanitary_certificate_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether phytosanitary certificate required (plants, agricultural products).

parameters.name: product_veterinary_certificate_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether veterinary certificate required (animal products).

parameters.name: product_halal_certification_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether Halal certification required (certain Muslim-majority countries).

parameters.name: product_kosher_certification_required_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether Kosher certification required (Israel, certain markets).

parameters.name: incoterm_recommended
parameters.purpose: Recommended Incoterm for this trade lane (e.g., 'FOB', 'CIF', 'DDP').
parameters.range: enum[EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF]

parameters.name: incoterm_cost_comparison_exw_vs_ddp_percent
parameters.purpose: Cost difference (%) between EXW and DDP Incoterms.

parameters.name: country_customs_digitalization_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 score of customs process digitalization (higher = more digital, faster).

parameters.name: country_ease_of_trading_across_borders_rank
parameters.purpose: World Bank rank for ease of trading across borders (lower = better).

parameters.name: country_customs_corruption_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for customs corruption (bribery, facilitation payments).

parameters.name: composite_customs_risk_score_country
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite customs risk score for country (delays, corruption, complexity).

parameters.name: composite_compliance_risk_score_product
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite compliance risk score for product (regulations, certifications).

parameters.name: composite_trade_facilitation_score_country_pair
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite trade facilitation score for country pair.
